en: A colorized vintage postcard showing a large, elegant building with a red-tiled roof, arched windows, and a long veranda covered with ivy and climbing plants. Formal garden paths and manicured flower beds lead up to the structure. The scene is labeled with German text at the bottom margin, indicating it is part of a military training area and specifically an officers' casino.
